blocks.name: Aakrit Subedi

blocks.text: Engineering manager and hands-on full-stack engineer with 6+ years building and leading web, mobile, and AI products. Progressed from Associate Software Engineer to Software Engineer, Tech Lead, and Engineering Manager across Leapfrog Technology and Naamche/reAlpha, and now Lead Engineer at Cantordust building pharmaceutical document intelligence. Led architecture, technical planning, delivery, and team development while shipping TypeScript and Node.js services, React applications, GraphQL APIs, PostgreSQL data models, AWS infrastructure, and LLM-powered features.

bullets.text: Building the ingestion and processing pipeline that parses raw pharmaceutical documents into structured, queryable data models.
Owning architecture across services, data model, retrieval layer, and the infrastructure it runs on.
Setting up repository structure, CI, deployments, and review practices for an early-stage product while scoping work with the team and domain experts.
Advanced from Software Engineer to Tech Lead and Engineering Manager, leading cross-functional delivery while remaining hands-on across backend, frontend, infrastructure, and LLM products.
Established architecture, code review, QA, design, and release practices across multiple product teams, improving consistency across the delivery lifecycle.
Owned system design, API contracts, CI/CD pipelines, AWS deployments, and production iteration for client and internal products.
Designed Node.js and TypeScript services and GraphQL APIs backed by PostgreSQL; applied caching and query tuning when justified by load.
Scoped ambiguous requirements into technical plans and estimates with stakeholders across the US, Nepal, Indonesia, and Singapore; aligned engineering capacity with portfolio priorities.
Rebuilt AiChat's conversational AI platform with prompt orchestration, grounded responses, async messaging, observability, model-cost controls, and WhatsApp, Messenger, and Instagram integrations.
